message:
The other day, I was rummaging through my closet and stumbled upon our family go-bags. It had been ages since I checked them, and I was pleasantly surprised to find everything still in order. I decided to update our emergency documents and refresh the snacks—who knew granola bars could last so long? 

It felt like a small win, but it gave me such peace of mind knowing we were a bit more prepared for whatever might come our way. Sometimes, it’s the little things that can make a world of difference. Have you checked your go-bag lately?
